name: Yamaha RD200
engine: 195 cc air-cooled two-stroke twin, two carbs, Autolube
intro: A small two-stroke twin that punches above its size. Two carbs, Autolube and points.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.
B: A two-stroke with leaking crank seals runs lean and can seize. Get the seals checked before riding hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
